scope: Limited manual assessment of 20 named/hash-verified images from 68 Babylon captures. Actual Babylon morph weights match the retained native diagnostic clips. No full-motion, compound-bend, appearance or production qualification.
observations: The four corrective targets survive standard GLB export/reimport and are active in the shipped Babylon inspector. Its recorded morph weights match the verified native clips at each captured bend; primary bind influences are zero. Both candidates reproduce all 16 recorded collision counts. All 68 views complete without browser errors.

At 90 degrees the portable correction changes native shoulder contacts 44/35 to 31/0 and hips 51/47 to 40/27, without count regressions, seam opening, severe-stretch edges or skeletal differences from the exact exported native control. All 45-degree cases remain zero. Elbows remain 0/0 and calves 0/2.

Selected front/back/side/skeleton rest views preserve the source silhouette, supported feet and bone layout. Selected 45-degree front views show intended independent limb movement without gross collapse.

Paired deep shoulder oblique views show a fuller shoulder cap, particularly on the right, but the broad rounded/root transition remains insufficiently anatomical. A contact-free right shoulder is not by itself a visual deformation pass. Current rear views confirm the broad shoulder-root shape remains.

Paired deep hip oblique views show a small change in the groin/root crease. Residual folds and abrupt shape transitions remain; current side views are partly occluded by the hand/arm, and front-facing raised thighs occlude parts of the hip. No seam separation is apparent in the inspected images, consistent with the numerical seam check.

These are single-axis diagnostic motions, not game clips. Intermediate angles, repeated cycles, compound/multi-axis poses and the production repair/retarget chain still need their own retained evidence. Only the 20 listed images were manually assessed.
decision: Retain the portable correction as a useful pipeline capability and unqualified diagnostic candidate. Keep the native and taper baselines immutable. Do not fit appearance, publish, or treat the numerical reduction as a finished anatomical repair. Next validate the baked interpolation and isolate the remaining shoulder/hip surface shape before production motion.
